subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should valid avatars above the inline projection budget be omitted, or should the gateway preserve their visibility through thumbnails or lazy references?
rationale: The canonical issue permits several durable designs, while silent omission changes visible behavior for existing valid stored avatars.

options.title: Bound and omit inline avatars
options.body: Cap both projected fields for every inline source, preserve dedicated delivery, document the fallback, and require live client proof.

options.title: Use thumbnails or references
options.body: Pause this patch and provide a small generated thumbnail or lazy fetch reference so oversized valid avatars remain visible.

recommendation.title: Bound and omit inline avatars
recommendation.body: Cap both projected fields for every inline source, preserve dedicated delivery, document the fallback, and require live client proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the current avatar projection and delivery boundaries this decision would change.
